name: CathAction (Jianu et al. 2024, AIRVLab)
what: about 500,000 fluoroscopy frames (600,000 in the 2026 revision) of endovascular catheterisation, animal and phantom, with action labels, collision labels and 25,000 to 40,000 catheter and guidewire masks; two zips, 4.35 GB and 9.88 GB
level_truth: none; no spine, much of it animal
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the largest real fluoroscopy frame pool in the open with no DUA, from clinical C-arms with live instruments: an exposure, noise and device-domain source beside coronary_angiography and fluoro_video_clips, not anatomy
licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (cc-by-nc-sa-4.0, as the Hugging Face page's licence line reads, read 2026-10-22), with a download form
how_to_get: Open https://huggingface.co/datasets/airvlab/CathAction and read the licence line.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py hf-get --repo airvlab/CathAction --repo-type dataset --dest DIR.
